scope: Reconstruct a declared candidate of the historical conservative mask recipe, require exact old mask pixels on all twelve targets before explaining UV rejection contributors. No mask edits or new registered assets.

construction.evidence: The old hash-bound uv-registration-v1 protocol and final mask-review record describe the recipe but do not identify a saved executable constructor, border settings or complete operation order. The following is a prospective candidate, not proof of historical implementation identity.
construction.landmarks: Use saved target-own generated-report 68 continuous finite XY in float64. Use numpy.rint then int32 only for polygon coordinates; reject int32 overflow and integer-degenerate hulls. Clip raster by the fixed image frame, never clamp individual landmark coordinates.
construction.hull: H: cv2.convexHull of rounded landmark indices0..26 inclusive; cv2.fillConvexPoly value255, LINE_8, shift0 in a zero uint8 image.
construction.erosion: E: erode H once with9x9 uint8 ones, anchor(-1,-1), BORDER_CONSTANT and borderValue255.
construction.mouth: M: convexHull/fillConvexPoly of rounded indices60..67 inclusive; dilate once with7x7 uint8 ones, anchor(-1,-1), BORDER_CONSTANT and borderValue0.
construction.base: base=E & not M; this priority assigns an E-and-M pixel to mouth exclusion even if it also lies in a reviewed band.
construction.reviewed_band: B: union of the saved reviewed half-open rectangular exclusions. Rectangles must have finite integer coordinates and positive extent wholly inside the fixed image; reject unsupported fields/kinds rather than invent a band.
construction.focus_band: For every004a63 target verify x0=0,x1_exclusive=image_width,y0=floor(min of original continuous eyebrow Y17..26)-18,y1_exclusive=650. Do not rint eyebrow points before floor. The eight082a27/006a55 targets require an empty exclusion list; fringe is outside this cohort.
construction.reason_priority: Exclusive partition: outside H; H and not E; E and M; E and not M and B; E and not M and not B. These are recipe-stage labels, not anatomical or physical occlusion truth.

equivalence_gate.comparison: Compare candidate allowed/occluded to the exact pinned L-mode PNG0/255 arrays, retaining XOR plus added/removed pixels and original/candidate totals for each of12 requests.
equivalence_gate.on_any_mismatch: Preserve every target and its mask diagnostics; emit no approved UV reason decomposition for any target. Do not tune borders, kernels, clipping or ordering based on the observed mismatch. A revised candidate needs an explicit version and another freeze.
equivalence_gate.interpretation: Twelve matching finite examples establish pixel equivalence on this frozen cohort, not recovery or identification of the original constructor.

uv_contributors.input: Use only the previously verified seven-array correspondence vectors, saved original classification and original UV report; bind every vector and mask to the exact target condition, metadata and112-input closure. No target/source geometry changes.
uv_contributors.domain: Only class5 mask_rejected texels are inspected; all other classes remain in requested denominators. Preserve global and the same four overlapping regions using saved region_bits.
uv_contributors.positive_weights: Inspect the four bilinear neighbors only when their exact weight is greater than0, clamp the upper neighbor at the image edge, and OR their reason bits. Zero-weight neighbors cannot create a reason.
uv_contributors.combinations: Report the15 nonzero mutually exclusive bitset combinations per global/region set; their sum must equal its existing mask_rejected count. A texel may have several pixel-stage reasons; do not add overlapping marginal counts as distinct texels.
uv_contributors.old_partition: Bits=8 iff old reviewed_occluder_only; bits1..7 iff old other_ineligible_only; bits9..15 iff old mixed_contributors. Require exact agreement with saved rejection_partition and old regional rejection totals.
uv_contributors.unknown: Do not query out-of-image samples, turn back-facing/self-occluded points into mask effects, fill unknown areas or claim the recipe labels explain NO_FACE.

integrity.before: Freeze this protocol, exact candidate/test/imported sources, metadata, all old112 pins and12 output-vector pins plus runtime before any candidate mask comparison. Read hash-verified bounded immutable bytes; validate ZIP/NPY headers and prohibit pickle before allocation.
integrity.after: Rehash all inputs, implementation, plan and runtime before publishing JSON. Drift invalidates all12 records and clears every decomposition, even when mask comparison was successful.
integrity.output: A new ignored output/research directory; JSON only. Refuse overwrite. Do not write candidate mask PNGs, photos, textures, NPZ or GLBs.
